nodes.note: The dry bed of Wend Mere in front of the Tallyhouse door: cracked mud, a few stranded reeds, the shrine's stone front ahead.

stations.note: Out on the mud a few strides from the shrine door, facing it: where a party carried out of the house stands to watch it.

nodes.note: The Tallyhouse porch, a low stone hall under the bell beam. The callbell hangs in the middle of it; a door on the left goes to the cell, the arch ahead to the sanctum.

stations.note: The callbell itself, hanging from the beam in the middle of the porch.

nodes.note: The house's one cell, off the porch: a stone room with a straw pallet and an iron ring in the back wall, where a debtor is chained until the reckoning.

stations.note: Where Tobin Reave stands chained by the ring in the back wall, facing the cell door.

nodes.note: The sanctum at the back of the house: the altar with its candles, the ledger on its stand beside a cold brazier, and the keeper waiting by the altar.

stations.note: Where Ysolde Marrow stands, in front of the altar, facing the arch the party comes in by.
The lectern the ledger lies open on.
The cold brazier beside the ledger stand.
The west end of the row of candles along the altar top.
